title: Don't override Git Credential Manager's enterprise default store when task exchange pins an unset store
outcome: Don't override Git Credential Manager's enterprise default store when task exchange pins an unset store
acceptance: When credential.credentialStore and GCM_CREDENTIAL_STORE are both unset, task exchange either refuses with a remedy asking the operator to set the store explicitly (as on Linux) or documents that it pins GCM's platform default and may override an administrator-configured enterprise default; the HTTPS-runner docs state the chosen behaviour
